html:
Does your home have street-facing windows or windows that your neighbours can see into? Privacy window film will help to eliminate the view from the outside during the day whilst ensuring you still have natural light entering your home. Below, find out about the options for privacy window film we offer including one way privacy window film and decorative privacy window film.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted window tinting network. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years and specialise in privacy window film in Australia. We have stores located conveniently throughout Australia and all our films are exclusive to us – supplied by the largest supplier of window film in the world. Here are the benefits of our privacy window film available in Australia

The Best Privacy Window Film In Australia

Because privacy window film obscures the view into your home during the day from those on the outside, this means you no longer need to use blinds or curtains for privacy – so you can enjoy your privacy and also the view – whilst maintaining a light & bright home.

Our films are also fantastic for reducing heat & glare (no more annoying reflections on screens!) and they also help to keep your home safer in the event of accidental breakages, severe weather or if someone is trying to break into your home. When glass is broken, the window film helps to keep shattered glass together.

What makes our Privacy window film in Australia the best?

  • All our films are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality
  • We offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications (and up to 15 years for commercial applications)
  • We offer zero-interest payment plans with Afterpay
  • All films are installed by professionally trained installers

One Way Privacy Window Film

Our one way privacy window film offers the ultimate in privacy as it turns your windows into a mirror on the outside so people can’t see in. Our one way privacy window film is also a great option for office buildings.

Decorative Privacy Window Film

Our decorative privacy window film not only adds privacy but can also add artistic flair to your home or office. We use digital graphics and computer-cut technology to create designs – you can use one of our designs or you can customise your own, even add your logo to enhance the branding in your office space.

Decorative privacy window film can also be used for internal glass areas to create a divider in your home or office spaces.
